responsibility: Implements EBB-based scheduling on top of the generic Haifa scheduler infrastructure. It groups basic blocks into extended basic blocks, computes or reuses dependencies for those scheduling regions, sets up the sched_info hooks specific to EBB motion, initializes ready lists and per-region counters, handles control-flow corner cases such as moving jumps and splitting blocks, and drives schedule_block over each EBB. It is the front end for superblock-like scheduling regions, distinct from full region scheduling in sched-rgn.cc.
